evidence_to_attach: filled copy of docs/validation/companion-screen-wb55-touch-visual-review-template.md or equivalent structured records
machine_state currently links the last runtime-proven revision logs; rev53 provision/normal logs are still pending in the runtime recheck report
serial/runtime diagnostic tail if flashed during the session
photo or short video only when the operator chooses to capture visual evidence
if old marks are visible, classify them as physical afterimage, stale queued frame, stale asset revision, rescue/procedural fallback leakage, or stale_generation_content
issue triage: fixed, deferred by product decision, accepted benign, or still open
machine_precondition: NO_GO_RUNTIME_RECHECK_PENDING: do not start human touch/visual steps until rev53 provision and normal runtime logs pass and promotion is applied.

operator_steps.operator_action: 在日常表情页轻点上/中/下几个位置，不要长按。
operator_steps.regression_guard: tap must remain separate from anywhere 3 s menu entry
operator_steps.success_signal: 表情看向触点并有整张内脸反应；不会误进入菜单。
operator_steps.title: Daily face tap keeps social mode

operator_steps.operator_action: 在日常表情页分别左/右/上/下滑动。
operator_steps.regression_guard: ordinary swipes must keep feeding pet_behavior instead of navigation
operator_steps.success_signal: 四个方向都有方向化表情反应；左右滑不会进入菜单。
operator_steps.title: Daily swipes become pet reactions

operator_steps.operator_action: 按住屏幕任意位置约 3 秒，保持近似静止。
operator_steps.regression_guard: menu entry remains a deliberate anywhere long press
operator_steps.success_signal: 约 650 ms 先出现逗弄反馈，约 3 s 后进入菜单。
operator_steps.title: Anywhere hold enters menu deliberately

operator_steps.operator_action: 进入菜单后在六项首页上下划动，不要点击菜单项。
operator_steps.regression_guard: one owner-approved static home frame per language must replace numbered menu scroll frames
operator_steps.success_signal: 首页保持六项生图布局，不选中条目、不切到旧滚动页，也不出现假刷新。
operator_steps.title: Static menu home ignores vertical stroke

operator_steps.operator_action: 点击任一菜单项，进入详情页后从左边缘右滑返回。
operator_steps.regression_guard: press-cue and target-arrival partial refreshes must not collapse into multi-flash full refresh
operator_steps.success_signal: 点击项先有被选中的 press-cue，再到详情页；返回手势可用。
operator_steps.title: Row press shows entry feedback

operator_steps.operator_action: 进入 Phone Link；在设备未连接时轻点 Reconnect 一次，并保留串口日志。
operator_steps.regression_guard: Reconnect must issue one guarded advertising request without disturbing an active link or pretending that a retry succeeded
operator_steps.success_signal: 该行显示 ADV；串口同时出现 phone_reconnect 和 advertising request 日志。若已连接则显示 LINK，命令失败才显示 ERR。
operator_steps.title: Phone reconnect requests guarded advertising

operator_steps.operator_action: 进入偏好页切换中文/英文，再返回主页检查。
operator_steps.regression_guard: single Chinese or single English mode must stay product-wide
operator_steps.success_signal: 每次只显示一种语言；主页和详情页语言一致。
operator_steps.title: Language toggle stays single-language

operator_steps.operator_action: 完成一次点击或拖动后放手等待约 2 秒。
operator_steps.regression_guard: 0xCF maintenance must stay post-contact and perceived as one quiet cleanup
operator_steps.success_signal: 只出现一次低闪维护感；没有连续多次全刷闪烁。
operator_steps.title: Maintenance is one quiet cleanup

operator_steps.operator_action: 在轻点、滑动、菜单进入前后观察表情整体质感。
operator_steps.regression_guard: future art tuning must go through genref_sheet_12_inner_faces_v5 style anchors
operator_steps.success_signal: 眼睛、眉、嘴鼻、腮线和小标记共同变化；不像只播放固定眼睛模板。
operator_steps.title: Pet expression feels alive enough for next art pass

post_session_rule: Every non-empty operator note is a task input. Fix AI-solvable issues with machine evidence before asking for another focused review.
purpose: Focused asynchronous operator packet for the only remaining Companion screen gate: touch feel, menu feel, language switching, pet reactions, and perceived 0xCF maintenance flicker.

review_note_triage_contract.publishable_pass_rule: The acceptance packet cannot be treated as publishable PASS while any triage item remains open_requires_fix, lacks an evidence_path, or accepts recognizable stale_generation_content as benign.
review_note_triage_contract.re_review_rule: Ask for another focused review only for the fixed item or the smallest touched behavior, not for already accepted steps unless the fix can plausibly regress them.
review_note_triage_contract.scope: Every non-empty operator note from this packet, even on a PASS step.

start_rule: Do not start this packet until rev53 runtime logs PASS, promotion is applied, pre-acceptance health PASS, and the operator explicitly says 开始验收.
